assertions.evidence: There is no score question object with ordered levels; the code directly computes an int (UrgencyDecision.score) via rules in _combine rather than defining a score question.
format_for_dashboard(decision) uses decision.score, which is computed in code by _combine and returned by UrgencyRater.rate; no second model call or model-generated value is used.
UrgencyRater.rate takes separate named parameters text: str and service: str, keeping report text and service name as distinct fields.
